data.name: Voxel Delvers
data.detailed_description:
Voxel Delvers is a cooperative action dungeon crawler for 1-4 players. Descend into procedurally generated crypts, caves, castles, and forests. Battle hordes of undead, outmaneuver deadly bosses, and claim powerful loot as you push ever deeper.

Choose Your Delver

Four distinct classes with unique playstyles and abilities:

  • Theron — The stalwart defender. Taunt enemies, raise your shield, and protect your allies with unbreakable resolve.

  • Sera — The holy healer. Smite foes with divine light while keeping your party alive through the darkest encounters.

  • Kira — The shadow assassin. Strike from the darkness, teleport behind enemies, and unleash devastating critical hits.

  • Vex — The arcane mage. Rain fire and frost upon your enemies. Blink through danger and obliterate rooms with devastating spells.

Delve Deeper

Each dungeon is procedurally generated—rooms, corridors, enemy placements, and loot are different every run. Five handcrafted dungeon templates ranging from quick boss rushes to sprawling labyrinths ensure variety in every session.

Progress through 100+ depth levels. Enemies grow stronger, but so does the loot. Push your limits and unlock access to deeper, deadlier dungeons.

Fight Together

True cooperative gameplay with a threat system that rewards coordination. Tanks taunt enemies away from squishier allies. Healers manage group health while contributing damage. Assassins and mages maximize damage from safe positions.

Every player gets their own loot drops—no fighting over gear. Boss chests guarantee rewards for everyone who participated in the kill.

Gear Up

Discover equipment ranging from common to legendary quality. Each piece rolls randomized stats that scale with dungeon depth. Build your character through strategic gear choices across 8 equipment slots.

Visit the town vendor between runs to buy upgrades or sell unwanted loot.

Cloud Saves

Your progress is saved to the cloud. Pick up where you left off on any machine.

data.short_description: Descend into procedurally generated dungeons with up to 4 players. Master 4 unique classes, slay bosses, claim legendary loot, and push deeper into the darkness. A voxel co-op dungeon crawler where every run is different.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 960 or equivalent
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 or equivalent
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus or equivalent
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 (Monterey) or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU or dedicated GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
